lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, Kaveri Finance inda call maadthirodu. Manjunath Shetty avara phone alva?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Nimma bike loan EMI four thousand one hundred rupees, November eradane thareeku due ittu. Yaake innu kattilla?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಈ ತಿಂಗಳು business ಸರಿ ಇಲ್ಲ sir, shop ಅಲ್ಲಿ sales ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.
lines.roman: Ee thingalu business sari illa sir, shop alli sales enoo illa.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Adella nanage gottilla. Loan thagondaaga gotthiralilva? Ivattu kattbeku.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಇವತ್ತು ಆಗಲ್ಲ sir, ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ದುಡ್ಡಿಲ್ಲ. ಒಂದು ಹತ್ತು ದಿನ time ಕೊಡಿ.
lines.roman: Ivattu aagalla sir, kaiyalli duddilla. Ondu hatthu dina time kodi.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hatthu dina ella aagalla. Neevu kattilla andre namma field team nimma manege barthaare, nimma neighbours ellarigu gotthaagutte.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಏನ್ sir ಇದು, ಮನೆಗೆ ಬರ್ತೀರಾ? ಇದು ಸರಿ ಅಲ್ಲ.
lines.roman: En sir idu, manege bartheera? Idu sari alla.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sari alla anta helbedi. Neevu defaulter. Legal notice kooda kalisthivi, police case aagutte.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ನೀವು ಹೀಗೆ ಮಾತಾಡಿದ್ರೆ ನಾನು ಏನೂ pay ಮಾಡಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ manager number ಕೊಡಿ.
lines.roman: Neevu heege maathadidre naanu enoo pay maadalla. Nimma manager number kodi.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Manager ge yaake? Duddu kattodu neevu.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ನಾನು ಈಗ ಏನೂ commit ಮಾಡಲ್ಲ. ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ branch ಗೆ ಬಂದು ಮಾತಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
lines.roman: Naanu eega enoo commit maadalla. Bekaadre branch ge bandu maathadthini.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Okay, then face the consequences. Bye.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer refused to commit to any payment after the agent threatened a home visit and police case.
analysis.summary: Borrower missed the November EMI due to a slowdown in his shop and asked for ten days. Agent rejected the request, threatened a field visit, legal notice and police case, and the customer refused to commit.
analysis.observations: Serious RBI fair-practice breach: threatening a home visit with neighbours finding out, calling the customer a 'defaulter' and invoking police for a 1-month delay. A recoverable early-bucket account (customer asked for only ten days) was turned into a refusal and likely complaint.
analysis.improvements: Immediate coaching and call review for compliance. Acknowledge the business slowdown, explain the late fee factually, and negotiate a dated PTP within the ten days requested instead of escalating; provide the manager/grievance contact when asked.

op_greet_company.rationale: Said 'Hello' and named Kaveri Finance, though no proper greeting.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Asked whether it was Manjunath Shetty's phone and he confirmed it was him; minimal verification.

pr_state_dues.rationale: Stated ₹4,100 EMI and the 2 November due date.

pr_late_fee_info.rationale: No factual late-fee or credit-score information; used legal/police threats instead.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: Asked 'Yaake innu kattilla?', albeit in an accusatory tone.

ds_empathy.rationale: Dismissed the business slowdown with 'Adella nanage gottilla'.

cp_no_threats.rationale: Threatened a field-team home visit with neighbours finding out, then legal notice and police case.

cp_respectful.rationale: Called the customer a 'defaulter' and ended with 'face the consequences'.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: No loan details were actually shared with anyone else, though exposure to neighbours was threatened.

cl_ptp_secured.rationale: No promise-to-pay; customer refused to commit.

cl_recap.rationale: Call ended abruptly with no recap or next step.
